requirements.statement: Freeze every authority, predecessor, review and current observation input. Secret scan v2 is current; v1 is historical-only.
requirements.proof: Every admitted use resolves to one exact root and claim class; absence, substitution, duplicate or forbidden promotion denies.

requirements.statement: Define closed typed schemas, canonical JSON, domain-separated SHA-256 identities and repository-relative locator grammar.
requirements.proof: Two independent stdlib readers reject unknown fields, ambiguous encodings, absolute or parent-relative paths, URI locators and unsupported operations.

requirements.statement: Make PUBLIC the only permitted visibility in normal, rollback and incident states.
requirements.proof: Any Private value or visibility-change remediation denies; current readback must equal PUBLIC.

requirements.statement: Bind the logical root to the Public repository root and prohibit outer or host-specific repository authority.
requirements.proof: Every command, locator and receipt binds the logical root; wrong-root, absolute-root or unresolved-root cases deny before mutation.

requirements.statement: Bind current GitHub, Legacy, license and Secret observations and preserve supersession semantics.
requirements.proof: Secret v1 cannot satisfy current history claims; any missing correction or unexplained continuity break denies.

requirements.statement: Define private evidence custody, disclosure-safe Public projections, trusted-time absence and immutable receipt lifecycle.
requirements.proof: Replacement, replay, clock substitution, unauthorized access, broken custody or Public equality-oracle output denies.

requirements.statement: Declare exactly one typed producer per output and distinguish external bootstrap definitions from produced objects.
requirements.proof: Producer/output cardinality is one-to-one; duplicate, hidden, self-object dependency or executable-root absence blocks implementation credit.

requirements.statement: Materialize the complete typed producer and object dependency graph.
requirements.proof: Two graph readers agree on all nodes and edges; unknown, forward, self, duplicate, hidden or cyclic edges deny.

requirements.statement: Admit every Finding from the predecessor and v2 hostile review with no fixed predecessor-only ceiling.
requirements.proof: Exactly 59 current identities resolve one-to-one; omission, range, Merge, suppression or presence-only credit denies.

requirements.statement: Freeze exact remote heads, Pull Request refs, tags, reachable object closure and explicit unknown denominators.
requirements.proof: Expected counts and roots bind acquisition; missing ref identity, stale head, unreachable/fork/inaccessible ambiguity or parser disagreement blocks COMPLETE.

requirements.statement: Freeze current worktree, index, untracked, ignored and submodule state after writers stop.
requirements.proof: Any writer, unclassified entry, index/worktree mismatch, sparse/shallow ambiguity or stale snapshot denies.

requirements.statement: Classify every mutable entry and preserve user-owned work without implicit deletion or overwrite.
requirements.proof: Unresolved ownership, overlap, deletion, replacement or merge conflict denies the changeset.

requirements.statement: Bind local generated outputs, caches, archives, code generation and compiled assets to exact provenance.
requirements.proof: Undeclared input, changed tool, stale output, ignored-to-Public promotion or unexplained nondeterminism denies.

requirements.statement: Constrain build, upload, archive, container and deploy contexts to explicit Product-root includes.
requirements.proof: Parent, outer, sibling, broad glob or undeclared archive member denies before build or upload.

requirements.statement: Preserve Legacy quarantine across copies, transforms, generated output, history and semantic reuse.
requirements.proof: Copied, renamed, normalized, encoded, archived, generated or behaviorally recreated risky content denies without one-item closure.

requirements.statement: Enumerate forks, Pull Requests, Issues, Discussions, Actions logs/artifacts/caches, Releases, packages, deployments, Wiki and previews.
requirements.proof: Every eligible surface has exact state; inaccessible, withheld, rate-limited or unknown surfaces block COMPLETE.

requirements.statement: Define Secret, PII, customer, employee, special-category and non-secret-sensitive publication policy.
requirements.proof: Unknown class, authority, tenant, retention or detector coverage denies; Public output leaks no value or equality oracle.

requirements.statement: Bind all current history and proposed-snapshot Secret candidates in a private redacted ledger.
requirements.proof: Open, duplicate-unresolved, ownerless or untriaged candidate remains blocking; confirmed credentials require revoke/rotate first.

requirements.statement: Require two independently rooted scanners and selected-provider custom patterns over identical frozen roots.
requirements.proof: Missing second scanner, unsupported class, corpus miss, custom-pattern gap, bypass or log leak denies.

requirements.statement: Encode interim no-license, Contributions-closed, Release/package-blocked state and exact Legal successor transition.
requirements.proof: Contribution, license addition, Open Source claim, package or binary Release denies until counsel-approved roots exist.

requirements.statement: Bind every code, document, image, font, dataset, fixture, generated output and copied specification byte to publication rights.
requirements.proof: Missing, conflicting, incompatible or unverifiable provenance denies even when the byte is not shipped.

requirements.statement: Produce the exact content-addressed allowlist for one proposed Public changeset.
requirements.proof: Added, omitted, renamed, mode-changed, generated, unlicensed, unresolved or surplus object invalidates the allowlist.

requirements.statement: Close runtime, development, optional, peer, workspace and transitive dependency/SBOM/vulnerability denominators.
requirements.proof: Omission, lock/install mismatch, vulnerable reachable component, stale advisory or expired exception denies.

requirements.statement: Root Actions, reusable/local/container actions, images, tools, downloads, native binaries and transitive executables.
requirements.proof: Mutable tag, moved image, wrong fork, checksum mismatch, missing owner or expired review denies before execution.

requirements.statement: Inventory every workflow and reusable workflow by exact root and full behavior.
requirements.proof: Unknown trigger, expression, reusable edge, permission, input, sink or side effect denies.

requirements.statement: Define a closed default-DENY trust row for every workflow/event/actor/ref combination.
requirements.proof: Fork, edited workflow, privileged target, workflow-run artifact, issue comment, dispatch and unknown combination vectors deny.

requirements.statement: Prevent attacker-controlled context interpolation and argument substitution.
requirements.proof: Every tainted source-to-sink path crosses an approved typed boundary; injection or substitution denies without side effect.

requirements.statement: Separate untrusted build/test from signer, OIDC, deployment and release privilege.
requirements.proof: No untrusted path reaches write token, Secret, environment or signer except a digest-bound validated transition.

requirements.statement: Partition caches and bind artifacts before privileged reuse.
requirements.proof: Low-trust restore or producer/head/digest/schema/retention mismatch denies consumption.

requirements.statement: Bind runner image, tools, downloads, egress and workspace inheritance.
requirements.proof: Unknown image, host, download, checksum or workspace inheritance denies; credentials never precede untrusted install.

requirements.statement: Bind required checks to exact source and tested SHA, including merge-group behavior.
requirements.proof: Wrong-source, stale, skipped, missing or wrong-SHA status denies.

requirements.statement: Protect CODEOWNERS/workflows with catch-all, validated patterns and an independent second approval.
requirements.proof: Invalid ownership, one-owner-only, self-review or unprotected ownership change denies.

requirements.statement: Separate deny-by-default branch, tag, push-protection, environment, Actions, release and expunging bypasses.
requirements.proof: Unlisted, self, admin, stale, overbroad or unreviewed bypass denies.

requirements.statement: Define separate exact active branch and tag Rulesets while PUBLIC.
requirements.proof: Force/update/delete, stale approval, wrong check source, one-person sensitive review or wrong signature behavior denies.

requirements.statement: Authorize GitHub settings changes separately from code Push with exact before/after CAS and rollback.
requirements.proof: Wrong repository, stale before-state, omitted/reordered operation, partial apply, concurrent change or mismatched readback denies.

requirements.statement: Bind every human, App, token, deploy key and recovery identity to least privilege and lifecycle.
requirements.proof: Unknown admin, classic PAT, write deploy key, permanent bypass or failed revocation denies.

requirements.statement: Produce one exact provider-specific OIDC policy per selected role after the neutral identity model.
requirements.proof: Omitted role, wrong claim/audience/ref/environment/repository, replay, expiry or long-lived fallback denies.

requirements.statement: Separate staging/production and bind dispatch, review, inputs, concurrency and Secret release.
requirements.proof: Wrong actor/ref/input, self-review, duplicate concurrency or pre-approval Secret access denies.

requirements.statement: Bind deployment target, plan/apply, health, drift, data compatibility and tested rollback.
requirements.proof: Wrong target/config/artifact, stale plan, partial apply, concurrent deploy, health failure, drift or unsafe rollback denies.

requirements.statement: Bind complete build recipe/materials and reproducibility or explicit bounded variance.
requirements.proof: Omitted or substituted source/material/tool/flag/environment, digest mismatch or unexplained nondeterminism denies.

requirements.statement: Bind protected tag, reviewed Commit, immutable release, assets, packages and consumer coordinates.
requirements.proof: Tag move/delete, asset replacement, coordinate/digest/publisher/source mismatch denies.

requirements.statement: Bind attestation producer and independent consumer policy to exact artifact and build roots.
requirements.proof: Wrong or missing subject, signer, repository, workflow, environment, bundle or prohibited metadata denies.

requirements.statement: Separate exact SLSA version, Source/Build Tracks and Levels with no presence-only credit.
requirements.proof: Any unproved requirement or attestation-only promotion leaves claim none.

requirements.statement: Handle bad releases through immutable successor, trust revocation, consumer notice and compatible rollback.
requirements.proof: Compromised release cannot remain recommended; missing surface action, notification or reviewed rollback denies.

requirements.statement: Define private coordinated vulnerability handling and independent fix verification.
requirements.proof: Public exploit detail, missed target, unverified fix or unauthorized publication denies.

requirements.statement: Cover identity, Ruleset, Action, dependency, runner, OIDC, signer, release, availability and evidence compromise.
requirements.proof: Compromised evidence cannot self-attest recovery; every scenario reaches deterministic containment and re-rooted verification.

requirements.statement: Produce closed source denominator, exact custody, conflict preservation and successor-only freshness.
requirements.proof: Uncaptured, stale, conflicting, fetch-failed or unlicensed source remains BLOCKED or UNKNOWN.

requirements.statement: Bind AI BOM, threat applicability, controls, TEVV, change invalidation and side-effect disablement.
requirements.proof: Unknown component/threat, poisoned context/tool/memory, stale approval, drift or failed evaluation disables side effects.

requirements.statement: Define named local, GitHub, provider, deployment, release and consumer readback classes.
requirements.proof: Missing, stale, mutable, inaccessible, conflicting or disclosure-unsafe evidence denies; a checkbox or positive run is insufficient.

requirements.statement: Define finite canonical mutation operations and causal field oracles executable without prose.
requirements.proof: Unsupported operation, unknown field, oracle mismatch, implementation absence or prose fallback denies.

requirements.statement: Provide exactly one separately traceable executable negative vector per admitted Finding.
requirements.proof: Exactly 59 vectors execute; omission, duplicate Finding, range, Merge, presence-only body or terminal mismatch denies.

requirements.statement: Bind every admitted Finding to exact Requirements, vector, evidence and independent disposition.
requirements.proof: Exactly 59 detached records exist; any orphan, duplicate, range, Merge, suppression, absent evidence or self-closure denies.

requirements.statement: Reconcile every current review without a 32-only ceiling or scope suppression.
requirements.proof: Author/self review, omitted Finding, collusion, invalid disposition, veto, stale or reordered event denies.

requirements.statement: Bind the complete package, every admitted Finding and current observation root in one acceptance CAS.
requirements.proof: Any open Finding, absent implementation/evidence, stale observation, changed dependency or missing authority keeps Acceptance zero.

requirements.statement: Permit only one exact atomic Public Push after full Acceptance and fresh current-head/time/readback checks.
requirements.proof: Missing, stale, conflicting, replayed, expired, revoked, used, wrong-head, extra-object or non-atomic transition denies; visibility remains PUBLIC.

requirements.statement: Separate privileged deploy/release authority from Push and assert bounded v3 acceptance only after every dependency and all 59 Findings close.
requirements.proof: Push PASS cannot satisfy deploy/release; implementation/evidence roots are absent, so current Acceptance remains zero and Gate29 remains BLOCKED.
